audit.operation: {"operation":"replace_planning_collection","field":"authority_boundary","values":["The #191 voter cut remains exact and unchanged; learner admission never enters a voter configuration or quorum","Merged #201 exposes coarse AuthorityOperationKind::Membership authority plus byte-identical retained artifact bytes through a crate-private sealed accessor; EnrollNonVoting and RemoveVoter are canonical issue-local artifact discriminators, never #201 enum variants or values of an operation_kind field","Only a crate-private #202 adapter may consume the sealed #201 artifact, require the coarse Membership class, and validate exact canonical domain, bytes, digest, and issue-local discriminator before decoding any learner or exclusion field; no public accessor or generic artifact conversion is added","Only a durably published Membership operation whose exact artifact validates EnrollNonVoting can construct a learner admission, and only one whose exact artifact validates RemoveVoter can activate pending exclusion","The learner may receive AppendEntries and InstallSnapshot only and cannot vote, endorse, finalize, renew, mutate, act as Shepherd, or own/serve Observatory","A recovery learner requires a separate current operation, certificate, boot generation, operation namespace, and catch-up boundary","#202 remains unbound and edits no product source while #200 is active or unmerged; after #200 merges, #202 synchronizes to exact merged #200 ancestry and revalidates before binding because both issues own authority_protocol.rs, polis_runtime.rs, and distributed/mod.rs","Joint/final membership and promotion belong to #199; concrete stores belong to #200"]}
